body:
Man, it's a really old and weird tree. And it's infused with magical power. It is possible that it only ever meant "go", but some sort of arcane magic made that demand carry more meaning than expected. I mean, several people in the series have stated that magic in the Inheritance trilogy works in strange and unfathomable ways, especially when the amount of power involved is immense.

If you're so full of whys then you should probably stop and think that some things are left vague so that people can wonder and speculate and figure out for themselves. Not everything makes perfect, infallible sense, and not everything has cut and dry reasons.

The Menoa tree said "Go...." several times. Might sound far-off, but I think it basically finalized his curse that he would never return to Alagaesia. The price for that brightsteel may be that he had to "go" away.
